# Prismor shadow-agent inventory

Records from `prismor discover`. UserHash is an HMAC, not a username. Secret values are not in this table.

content.query:
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Managed == false and Kind != "diagnostic"
| summarize records = count() by Surface, Kind
| order by records desc
content.title: Shadow records by surface

content.query:
PrismorAIInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RiskLevel in ('high', 'critical')
| project TimeGenerated, RiskLevel, Kind, Name, Product, EntityKey, HostId
content.title: High and critical
